messages.subject: Ember — internal: report on title sign-off + risks
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Elena,

Report on title is ready to go to the client (draft attached to the file). Three things I want us aligned on before it goes out:
1. Clydesford charge — we hold the line on discharge/undertaking at completion, no money released without it.
2. Restrictive covenant indemnity — I've got an indicative quote of £3,950 for £25m cover; recommend client takes it given the price.
3. Brindley service-charge query — covered by the £100k retention; I don't think it's material but we should flag it.

Anything to add before I send?

James
